referents.why: 'Of Him' (third masculine singular) of 'glory': God, the only masculine singular candidate that fits, w5.
Interrogative 'why' (ti): refers to nothing; no neuter singular candidate.
'Also I' (first singular) is the objector's I inside the imagined speech; no first-person candidate.

links.why: Reversed: the protasis cl1 is the condition of cl0, 'why am I still judged'.
'If my lie accentuates God's truthfulness, why am I still judged?' cl0 is conditioned by cl1.
The relation is conditional, not a plain and; the kai in cl0 ('also I') does not link these clauses.
